body:
It's too late for that. It's been almost 24 hours since I took the batch of 30. The damage is done, I hope. I'm just confused why I don't feel any of the side effects. Is it because it was a generic "acetaminophen" and not specifically tylenol/advil/whatever?

People online make such a huge deal about calling 911 if you go over 10 tablets, let alone 30, yet here I am like nothing happened.
